articles.title: Starwatch: Fleeting brilliance of Leonid meteor shower to hit peak
articles.description: Annual display appears to radiate from constellation of Leo in eastern sky as Earth passes through comet debris stream The annual Leonid meteor shower reaches its peak this week, offering a chance to count meteors. The shower is expected to be at its most active during the night of 17–18 November. Under ideal conditions, observers may see up to 10–15 meteors an hour.
